answers.core: I believe this will make Godot's UI feel more polished, and UI is something that I know is not a key thing for Godot as it is focused on function, but this change is tied to something that is practically unavoidable in the engine and having a way to just clean up your project without the dread of knowing that you're going to be clicking every arrow manually can be a nice way to keep a user progressing with their project, as they feel like their project can be cleaned in a matter of seconds.
answers.workaround: I have seen some good addons, so potentially there is a way to do this with an addon, but I think it would be beneficial if it comes with Godot natively, as this folding and unfolding action is done practically every time you use Godot.

title: Allow toggling folding of multiple nodes by dragging the mouse over folding arrows in the Scene tree dock
